reasons.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.

welcome.title: Welcome to Madar
welcome.body: You have an invitation to join your office in Madar.
welcome.setBody: Set a password. You sign in with this email and password from now on.
welcome.ended: This link has ended. Ask the Admin for a new invitation.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Type the email of your account. Madar sends a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account in Madar, a link is on its way. Check your email.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.body: Other devices sign out when you save the new password.
reset.ended: This link has ended. Ask for a new link.

expired.title: Your session ended
expired.body: Type your password to continue. This screen and your unsent words stay.

errors.wrong: The email or the password is not right.
errors.weak: This password is too easy to guess. Use a longer one.
errors.same: Use a password that is not your current one.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.offline: Madar cannot connect. Check your connection, then try again.
